active_alignment: Deposited terminal alignment; guide spacer plus NNN in both arms; join row_index to sites129.json, verify coordinates, guide, reads and return bits.
control_sampling: Lowest SHA256(aligned-control-v1<TAB>guide<TAB>chrom<TAB>strand<TAB>pam_coord) per guide, same number as treatment, RNA single gap, exactly four substitutions, literal NGG; smallest DNA string for alignment ties.
conversion: Replace deposited alignment - with _ before independently left-padding both 23-character strings to 24. All non-gap characters stay fixed.
cutoff: Strictly greater than exact rational 3/1000. No fitting or threshold changes.
precision: Unchanged float64 forward pass, stored weights promoted from float32.
scope: In-silico nominations; no cleavage, clinical risk or ranking-impact inference.
